description: Change a checkout: replace line_items, set buyer, apply a coupon code (discounts.codes) or choose a delivery option. Fields you omit stay as they are.

language.description: Preferred language for titles and descriptions: "en" or "he" (Hebrew). Default en.

fulfillment.description: To pick delivery: {"methods":[{"groups":[{"selected_option_id":"<option id>"}]}]}. Options are listed in the returned checkout.

line_items.description: Items to buy. item.id is a variant id from search_catalog (the product slug, or slug@ml for a volume variant).

meta.description: UCP request metadata, e.g. {"ucp-agent": {"profile": "<agent profile URL>"}}. Optional here.

name: update_checkout
